1926, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 32 Cont.
August 9th Mrs Eliz Kellogg 31 (14021 Young Ave) Enrolls To-day specially in Hon. St. Teresa that she may overcome her scrupulosity and have more confidence.
Remarkable Case Doctors all agree "Nothing to be done". Florine Rallinger 4 in October, Nashville Tinn. absolutely helpless since about 42 months olda, Specialists after Specialists are hopeless; is Enrolled to-night for one year.
Aug. 19th Lew. Freeman, about 37, an engineer unxpectedly lost his position To-day, comes this evening to enroll before looking for other employment.
25 th Insanity Cured Napoleon Belair 18, Ticompic, Ont. only help of Mother Enrolled at the time in the Asylum in London reported O.K. To-day.
Aug. 17 Property Lost or Sold? Mrs. Cath. Starrs, widow at 1755 - 14th Ave. having 3 daughters & aged father (80), anxious lest she lose her property, for taxes. Enrolls for year while promising better.
Page 33
Sept. 3rd Strepticoptic Infection of Lungs & Hopeless Heart - leakage. Hon. Judge Patrick Joseph Mary Holly, 59, now in St. Mary's Hospital took sick during trip in the East with wife & sons and arrived in Detroit - St. Mary's Hospital July 30 was enrolled 2nd time Aug 20th when all doctors and nurses and family seemed hopless. To- day Sept. 3 condition reported not worse except gradual weakness increasing; we enroll him again. Please God, waiting for good report. - His wife and children promissing frequent & daily com. . ... Same day 9 p.m. Mrs. Holly phones "improvement".
Sept. 4 8.45 p.m. poison reported as leaving his blood, doctor have some hope again -
Sept. 5th perspiring freely - a good sign if strength keeps up. Sept. 6 ..... Very weak - no apetite, less hopeful. 7th Some improvement again. Sept. 8 B. V.M. Nat: - Very, Very much improved.
9th Mrs. Holly reports personly - Improvement still ..
12th Bad turn.
14th Recd. USA Papal Ben. by cable. . . .
Oct. 3rd Leaves Hospital hopeful .... happy!
